description: Decide which cognitive operations are worth running for the situation at hand, and get back BOTH what to run and what was skipped with the reason for each. Optional: agent_id (uses that agent's expression profile), budget (cost units, default 40 — roughly every cheap check plus one reasoning call), force (gene ids to run regardless), and the signals: uncertainty, urgency, novelty, risk, goal_relevance, decision_importance (each 0..1, absent counts as 0). Use before a consequential step instead of doing everything or guessing what to skip.

force.description: Gene ids to run regardless of the plan

name: plan_cognition
